page.notes: The running head "CAP. II: 4." at the top left is a section marker, not part of the running title, so it is left out of running_head. The Hebrew letter ב opening the last paragraph is transcribed as printed. Doubtful readings: "servitutem" (the word is partly smudged) and "suisque" (the q is unclear). Dropped "s" long s was read as "i" in "istius". The line "ab" is treated as the catchword. No printing errors were left unmarked.
